reviewer_role: Independent systems and visual critic; not the image/diagram builder or GitHub publisher
score_scope: R01-R13 static art, research and typed proposal content only; not a task-wide completion score

approved_clarifications.decision: Rear sleeves sit at prepared-food shelf height above closed raw-food cabinets; low utility stays below window. Historical requirement/checkpoint bytes remain unchanged.

D06 depicts the explicitly proposed initial serial storage-buffered installation. D02/D07 retain the full direct-feed/surplus/merge upgrade unchanged; no requirement mandated all catalogue routes in one overview.

Generic full receiving-buffer state plus explicit reservation/backpressure rules establish the proposed storage-full behavior. D03 and the ordinary camp scene are not misrepresented as full-house state panels.

requirements_review.original_requirement: All registered reference identities inventoried; every accessible source actually visually inspected at a declared level; unavailable full footage not claimed watched.
requirements_review.assessment: All 23 registered existing video identities and six stills are accounted for. Source agents inspected available visual evidence at declared levels; independent identity checks cover 10 full MP4 hashes, 122 storyboard sheets, source documents and requested sample ranges.
requirements_review.boundary: 13 YouTube sources remain storyboard-only. No end-to-end playback, audio, continuous-motion or throughput claim; critic crosschecks and integrity review are distinguished from source-agent coverage.

requirements_review.original_requirement: Additional first-party videos/documentation inspected and linked; distinguish game footage, ad presentation and real-world technical analogy.
requirements_review.assessment: Five actual first-party developer clips were visually sampled across three articles; additional first-party manufacturer pages/video descriptions inform physical analogies. Source topology, documented claims and design inference remain distinct.
requirements_review.boundary: Two core and two additional video candidates are metadata/documentation-only. Five sampled clips are from one publisher, not five independent publishers.

requirements_review.original_requirement: Each route names item form, source/output, destination/input, transfer direction and evidence/proposal status.
requirements_review.assessment: The full proposal has 37 station dispositions and 25 directed routes covering all 14 source equipment families. Initial mode adds a distinct nine-endpoint/eight-transfer record. Named ports resolve out-to-in, carrier families match, item forms and proposal/source status are explicit.
requirements_review.boundary: Semantic item classes and allowed-catalogue predicates are not frozen executable SKU identifiers.

requirements_review.original_requirement: Machine-to-machine, machine-to-storage and storage-to-customer routes are explicit; future assembly recipe remains provisional.
requirements_review.assessment: Intake-to-cooker is visibly connected; separate A/B assembly inputs have their own study; initial camp visibly connects cooker to food storage and requested dispatch to counter buffer. Full direct/overflow/merge upgrade remains specified and rendered as modules. Exact assembly ingredients and ratios remain provisional.

requirements_review.original_requirement: No universal mixed-food/fuel/material loop; each outlet/filter declares compatible catalogue; raw log/meat sales allowed only by explicit counter catalogue.
requirements_review.assessment: Food-only classification, source-held incompatible timber and separate utility/material paths prevent universal mixed-resource circulation. Heater is warmth-only; raw logs/meat can be sold only when the explicit counter catalogue permits their actual form. No transport conversion of ore to ingots is asserted.

requirements_review.original_requirement: Storage original doors/apron, left window, rear vent and right fuel hatch preserved; low product sleeves are explicit new additions with local internal trays, not invisible routing.
requirements_review.assessment: D03 preserves original front doors/apron, high left window, rear vent and dedicated fuel hatch while explicitly adding new typed docks and local mechanisms. Utility has low landings and an indexed lift; food uses same-rear-wall shelf-height sleeves and a horizontal shuttle above closed raw-food cabinets. Camp rear-facing house has actual dock-tip connections and an unconnected closed fuel hatch.
requirements_review.boundary: The early generic low-sleeve wording is explicitly clarified: only utility remains low; rear food is raised. Far front facade is occluded in the camp view and is evidenced by D03 plus the recorded whole-house rotation, not falsely claimed visible.

requirements_review.original_requirement: Storage fuel, raw food, hides, cash/cargo remain explicitly manual in this first conveyor upgrade; no false full-storage automation claim.
requirements_review.assessment: Fuel, raw-food cabinets, hides, cargo/cash and undefined future production remain manual or disabled. No full-storage automation or invented weapon/ammunition recipe is claimed. The six-zone storage disposition and central aisle remain represented by the approved layout and local-bay cutaways.

requirements_review.original_requirement: Actual connection renders show supported surfaces, matched widths/heights, bridge plates/adapters and no intersecting legs or control access.
requirements_review.assessment: Actual selected pixels show supported straight/corner/incline geometry, silver transitions, finite dock landings, matched visible handoffs and grounded supports. Final camp curves join projecting IN/OUT mouths instead of house walls; cooker controls and counter pickup remain accessible.
requirements_review.boundary: Static reference-art physical readability only; no numerical dimensional fit, native mesh collision or moving-device test.

requirements_review.original_requirement: Finite buffers, blocked/full destinations, reject handling, reservation-based dispatch and prevention of store-in/store-out loops defined and illustrated.
requirements_review.assessment: Generic receiving buffer shows ready/full with next carrier held upstream; output and counter studies show actual full downstream stock; assembly shows missing-input and full-output waits. Wrong items remain recoverable off-line. Both route records define reservation ownership, finite capacity and no automatic storage OUT-to-IN path. Initial receiving-full waits do not disable valid requested dispatch that can free inventory.
requirements_review.boundary: D03 is an interface/mechanism sheet, not a full-house state illustration. Full storage behavior is evidenced by D02 receiving-full art plus the initial/D07 rules; no nonexistent panel is claimed.

requirements_review.original_requirement: Preserve canonical counter table/legs/shelf/register, staff controls, customer frontage; goods and cash separate.
requirements_review.assessment: Canonical timber table/register/legs/shelf remain recognizable. Standalone buffer ends at guarded PICKUP before the table; worker handoff is explicit. Final camp opens the outside customer face at the fence, keeps keypad and staff inside, and separates stock, cash collection pad and register.

requirements_review.original_requirement: Centered warmth furnace, two bidirectional gate approaches, storage entrance, staff paths and service clearance stay open; exact real-world scale/runtime fit not claimed.
requirements_review.assessment: Both selected layouts retain central stone warmth service and two distinct open bidirectional gate approaches. Final initial-mode camp has inset pond with continuous western paving into the northern service margin, clear cooker front and manual house-side access, and outside customer frontage. No conveyor crosses either main gate corridor.
requirements_review.boundary: D06 is an explicitly different initial placement; D07 is the full-upgrade allocation. No claim that they share an identical footprint or that either is a runtime pathfinding/collision certification.

requirements_review.original_requirement: Source style: sculpted rounded blue/orange/silver machinery, dark carry surfaces, warm timber; use inspected approved image inputs; no character redesign.
requirements_review.assessment: Seven selected studies follow the inspected rounded blue/orange/silver machinery, dark carrying surfaces, warm timber and winter camp assets. Original source images stay unchanged; docks/adapters/assembly are explicit proposals. No character redesign was introduced.

requirements_review.original_requirement: Separate critic inspects actual output multi-angle and use-state pixels, score at least 9.5 with every mandatory check passed; retain failed candidates and reviews.
requirements_review.assessment: A genuinely separate critic inspected all seven selected full native images, meaningful opposing views/interface closeups and ready/full/missing/wrong-item states across the set. Each selected study scores 9.8 with its mandatory checks passed. All 22 generated originals match their native returned bytes, invocation records and exact visual-review hashes; all failed versions and the no-image tool failure are locally retained.
requirements_review.boundary: Retention and provenance are locally verified here. Durable remote preservation belongs to R14 and remains unapproved by this content report.

readme_gallery_review.findings: Current prose separates initial and full upgrade modes, corrected research/ archive paths, source observations/proposals, explicit unavailable-stream limits and static-only scope. It does not mislabel source sampling as full playback. Final frozen link/alias resolution remains the archive checker responsibility.

publication_gate.original_requirement: Additive isolated art branch preserves baseline 4618 files and all originals; verified remote bodies/hash/path evidence; no runtime, workflow or main mutations.
publication_gate.required: Verify isolated additive package, all baseline files retained, exact selected aliases/original histories/prompts, correct local links and complete remote bodies/hash/path evidence. Bind this report by exact hash in acceptance-status.json, then issue separate delivery/remote verification receipts.

scope_limits: Static concept PNGs and exact editable vector/typed design specification; no native mesh, rig, moving simulation, structural or collision certificate.
No final recipes, numerical capacities, production speeds, costs or world dimensions.
Existing source coverage remains 10 full-file frame-sample audits plus 13 storyboard-only sources; no continuous playback or audio claim.
The critic independently validates selected actual pixels and source-audit outputs/identities; it does not claim to have replayed every source video.
D06 initial mode uses a new proposed enclosed-water site and rotated house; full-upgrade alternative placement remains in D07.
approval_boundary: All 13 content-scope requirements pass with no mandatory content check waived. R14 is still a separate required gate. This report must not be described as task-wide completion or proof that images are already in GitHub. No score averaging was used to excuse failed candidates; all rejected revisions remain excluded from selection and retained in history.
